headline: China approves 18 active ETFs to bolster stock market resilience
summary: The China Securities Regulatory Commission has approved 18 actively managed exchange-traded funds to channel capital into the A-share market and strengthen investor confidence.
why: The China Securities Regulatory Commission oversees mainland financial markets, and regulatory interventions are frequently deployed to stabilize domestic equities during economic downturns.

impacts.name: Chinese Equities
impacts.why: State-backed approval of active ETFs introduces fresh liquidity and institutional support to shore up local stock prices.

why_moved: Direct regulatory actions aimed at injecting liquidity and restoring market confidence encourage institutional buying and stabilize sentiment.
